titleEn: Pull It Up, Crunch and Munch!

pages.text: Dad set steaming greens on the table. But Kota slowly pushed the unfamiliar dish away. Picking only white rice, the spoon moved ever slower.
"I don't know it! I won't eat green!" Kota put the spoon down. Their tummy rumbled, and both hands quickly covered it.
At the next table, an elderly owl with big eyes finished every green. "So sweet! I'd like to see the garden where these grow." Kota pouted. "I'm not interested in green gardens."

Low steam drifted from the ditch through the back garden. Dad held Kota's hand and crouched by a row. "These leaves are a handle. Shall we pull out what's hidden?" "I'll pull one, too," the owl said, rolling his sleeves.
Kota gripped leaves with both hands and pulled. Soil split, and a white radish came up! "Wow, this was hiding underground?" "Found it!" The owl slapped his knee.
Dad wiped it with his waist towel. "Touch your nose to it. A sweet smell means sweet inside." Kota sniffed its gentle sweetness. "Then... I'll try Pull It Up, Crunch and Munch!"
Holding the radish, Kota took a crunchy bite. "Sweet! Really sweet inside!" Their striped tail shot up. Kota sang, "Pull It Up, Crunch and Munch!" The owl chuckled.
Kota's cheeks glowed and shoulders rose. Lifting the radish high, Kota called, "I pulled it!" Dad and the owl clapped. The pink towel fluttered up.

At lunch, leaves from Kota's radish arrived as cooked greens. Kota picked them up with chopsticks and counted. "One, sniff! Two, a crunchy bite! Three, chew and munch!" Their cheeks moved, full of food.
At sunset, Kota pointed to another leaf. "What's hiding under there?" Dad hugged from behind. "Unfamiliar things can hide something delicious." Kota laughed. "Tomorrow, Pull It Up, Crunch and Munch!"
